description: Get the lead summary of a Wikipedia article in any language edition: title, short description, plain-text extract, thumbnail and original image, coordinates, Wikidata id, last edit time and page link. Fuzzy title search. Attribution (CC BY-SA 4.0) included. ~0.5 s. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/wikipedia-summary.
